description: Source code for the xdiff library implementing file diff algorithms, including Myers' algorithm, with functions for computing differences, building change scripts, and handling diff groups.

classes.name: xdpsplit_t
classes.description: Structure representing a split point in the diff algorithm.

classes.name: xdlgroup
classes.description: Structure representing a group of changed lines in a file.

classes.name: split_measurement
classes.description: Holds measurements about a hypothetical split position for scoring.

classes.name: split_score
classes.description: Represents the score of a potential split, including effective indentation and penalty.

methods.name: xdl_split
methods.description: Performs the core divide-and-conquer split of the diff box using Myers' algorithm.

methods.name: xdl_recs_cmp
methods.description: Recursively compares record ranges in two files to identify differences.

methods.name: xdl_do_diff
methods.description: Main function to perform diff between two memory-mapped files, selecting algorithm based on flags.

methods.name: xdl_add_change
methods.description: Creates a new change record and links it into the change list.

methods.name: recs_match
methods.description: Checks if two records have the same minimal perfect hash.

methods.name: get_indent
methods.description: Calculates indentation level of a line, treating tabs as 8 spaces.

methods.name: measure_split
methods.description: Measures characteristics of a hypothetical split position for scoring.

methods.name: score_add_split
methods.description: Calculates a badness score for a split based on indentation and blank lines.

methods.name: score_cmp
methods.description: Compares two split scores to determine which is better.
